title: Oop! Footage Of Jonathan Majors Checking Man Who Asked For Meagan Good's Number Is Going Viral (WATCH) - NewsBreak
text: Roomies, footage of Jonathan Majors checking a man who asked for Meagan Good ‘s phone number is making its rounds and going viral online. On Wednesday, July 9, @ArtofDialogue_, a user on X, formerly known as Twitter, shared a clip of Majors and Good seemingly standing in an Apple store while posing for pictures with a fan. As the clip plays, the man, who later asks Good for her number, is heard commenting on the actress while she and Majors pose alongside a fan. “You’re beautiful in person,” he says to Good. “Just to let you know here.” As the clip rolls, Good and Majors continued to pose alongside the fan as the actress tells the man, “Thank you.” After the photo is snapped, the man then asks Good if he can take a picture with her. Then, as the man steps forward to stand alongside Good, he continues his question. “Possibly, like a [phone] number, [too]?” he asks. At that point, Good appears distracted. However, Majors wasn’t at all. He swiftly jumped in, asking the man, “Whose number?” The man replies, asserting that he’s asking for Good’s number, and Majors’ facial expression instantly changes to apparent disgust and disbelief. “My number? No. This is my man,” Good then jumps in and says to the man. However, Majors then adds, “Why don’t you go Google something, bro?” At that point, the camera pans to an apparent Apple employee who also appears to be in disbelief. Check out the clip below. Subsequently, social media users hopped into Instagram user @livebitez’s comment section to share their reactions to the viral interaction between the man, Meagan Good, and Jonathan Majors. Weeks before the man asked for Meagan Good’s phone number in the now-circulating clip, she and Jonathan Majors were turning heads on a red carpet. As The Shade Room previously reported, last month, the couple appeared at the Hollywood Unlocked Impact Awards. While walking the red carpet, Majors couldn’t keep his hands off Good, and the pair were not shy about showing off their affection for one another. The post appeared first on .
